cases.source: pub async fnc main(): int { await time.sleep(1ms); return 42; }
pub async fnc main(): int { await time.after(0ms); return 42; }
pub routine main(): void { await time.sleep(0ms); stdio.println(42); return; }
cases.note: The public root entrypoint already owns an implicit scheduler Task; this exception does not extend to ordinary synchronous helpers

cases.source: fnc main(): void { await time.after(0ms); stdio.println(45); return; }
cases.note: Root main is selected by zero-arity entrypoint identity, not public modifier

cases.source: define module helper fnc main(): void { await time.after(0ms); stdio.println(46); return; } end
cases.note: One unique module main is selected when no root main exists

cases.source: define module helper fnc main(int unused): void { await time.after(0ms); return; } end
cases.note: A nonzero-arity function named main is not a scheduler-owned entrypoint

cases.source: define actor Worker as receive(ActorMail<String> mail): void { val Channel<int> ch = Channel.new<int>(1); val Future<void> sent = nb writech ch, 7; await sent; self.send("resumed"); self.end(); return; } end pub async routine main(): void { val worker = spawn Worker(); await worker.get_ready(); worker.send("go"); val output = (await worker.outputs.next()).value.unwrap(); stdio.stdout.write(output.value); await worker.get_done(); return; }
cases.note: Compiled guest must execute an owned mailbox receive await and emit resumed, then observe get_done physical retirement; no nested source Task

cases.source: actor fnc worker(): int { val Channel<int> ch = Channel.new<int>(1); val Future<void> sent = nb writech ch, 42; await sent; return readch ch; } pub routine main(): void { stdio.stdout.write(worker()); return; }
cases.note: Actor fnc owns its mailbox turn, unlike ordinary sync fnc

cases.source: define actor Worker as on_start(): void { val Channel<int> ch = Channel.new<int>(1); val Future<void> sent = nb writech ch, 1; await sent; return; } receive(ActorMail<String> mail): void { self.end(); return; } end
cases.note: Actor startup must complete on its lifecycle turn before readiness; suspension remains forbidden

cases.note: An ordinary class method without async/suspends lacks suspension authority
